title: Make a compass from a needle 🧭
caption:
No phone, no map? A needle, a magnet and a bowl of water 🧭
Would you try this? 👇
first_comment: Saving this for the next camping trip? 🏕️👇
sources: Stroking steel with a magnet in one direction magnetises it (aligns magnetic domains): standard physics, e.g. Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'magnetization'
A floating magnetised needle aligns with Earth's magnetic field (the needle compass): NOAA / British Geological Survey geomagnetism education pages
